backend/main.mo: Main backend actor defining all types (user profiles, rituals, challenges, love languages, pairing, stats) and including MixinStorage and MixinAuthorization for blob storage and access control functionality.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting four Love Garden features (visualization component, XP/streak integration, dedicated page, growth animations) with associated files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Comprehensive summaries of all frontend files including components, pages, hooks, and configuration, detailing Love Garden animations, theme system, navigation, and feature implementations.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS with OKLCH color system for light/dark modes, romantic theme variables, and custom animations including garden-specific animations (garden-stage-enter, plant-unlock-animation, plant-card-highlight) with reduced-motion support.
frontend/index.html: Main HTML entry point with favicon links, viewport meta tags, theme initialization script to prevent flash, and root div for React mounting.
frontend/QA_ACCEPTANCE_CHECKLIST.md: QA checklist for Version 66 reset verification covering draft build label display, build stability, core functionality, and historical checklists for previous versions (76, 64, 63, 62).
frontend/QA_VERSION_66_RESET_REPORT.md: Verification report confirming successful Version 66 reset with passing status for draft build labels, build stability, all core features (landing, login, rituals, quiz, navigation, theme), and absence of post-v66 features.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that sets up QueryClient, ThemeProvider, InternetIdentityProvider, and conditionally renders Landing page or authenticated app with header, tabbed content, and bottom navigation.
frontend/src/components/BottomNav.tsx: Fixed bottom navigation bar component with six tabs (Home, Insights, Memories, Garden, Activities, Us) using icons and active state styling.
frontend/src/components/CompletionAnimat: Animated overlay component that displays floating hearts with randomized positions and delays for completion celebrations.
frontend/src/components/CoupleLevelXPMod: Card component displaying couple level, XP progress bar, and level label using insights data and level calculation utilities.
frontend/src/components/DataStates.tsx: Reusable UI components for loading, empty, error, and section header states with consistent styling and optional retry actions.
Card component for displaying plant information with locked/unlocked states, milestone details, XP requirements, and optional highlight animation.
frontend/src/components/HarmonyBreakdown: Card displaying current harmony percentage, 7-day trend sparkline, color-coded status, and expandable explanation of harmony calculation factors.
Compact button component showing harmony percentage and trend icon that navigates to Insights page when clicked.
frontend/src/components/LandingBrand.tsx: Brand logo component with image and text, supporting compact/default variants and text-only fallback on image load error.
frontend/src/components/LandingFooterLin: Dialog component that displays footer content (About, Contact, Terms, Privacy, Investor) in a modal with scrollable text sections. Uses shadcn/ui Dialog components and includes contact email integration.
frontend/src/components/LandingHeroScree: Displays a phone mockup with a carousel of landing page screenshots, featuring dot indicators for navigation. Renders a single screenshot at a time with a simulated phone frame including notch.
Expandable/collapsible founder story section that shows preview paragraphs by default with a "Read more/less" toggle button. Uses ChevronDown/Up icons and displays content from founderStory content file.
frontend/src/components/LandingScreensho: Full-featured screenshot carousel with previous/next buttons, auto-advance every 5 seconds, phone mockup frame, captions, and dot indicators. Includes keyboard navigation and accessibility labels.
frontend/src/components/LoginButton.tsx: Authentication button component that handles Internet Identity login/logout with loading states. Clears React Query cache on logout and includes error handling for duplicate authentication attempts.
frontend/src/components/LoveChallenges.t: Weekly challenge card component with photo upload capability for proof of completion. Includes loading/error states, completion animation, photo preview, and integration with backend challenge queries.
frontend/src/components/LoveGardenVisual: Visualizes garden progress with level-based stage images and unlocked plant overlays. Detects level changes and newly unlocked plants, with optional animations respecting reduced motion preferences.
frontend/src/components/OurLoveLanguages: Interactive card component for love languages feature with primary action button, insights shortcut link, and optional highlight animation. Displays status line and handles loading states.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetup.tsx: React component for initial user profile setup that prompts for a name, displays success state with animations, and triggers an onSuccess callback after submission.
frontend/src/components/RewardVisuals.ts: Displays gamification elements including challenge progress, streak boost multipliers, and milestone badges using insights data from the backend.
frontend/src/components/SpinWheel.tsx: Interactive spinning wheel component that randomly selects a love language daily, with smooth easing animations and localStorage persistence to prevent multiple spins per day.
frontend/src/components/StreakMilestoneB: Shows streak milestone badges (3, 7, 14, 30, 60, 100 days) with locked/unlocked states based on the user's current streak from insights data.
frontend/src/components/ThemeToggle.tsx: Simple button component that toggles between light and dark themes using a custom useTheme hook.
frontend/src/components/UnlockPacks.tsx: Displays activity packs for each love language that unlock progressively based on streak milestones (0, 3, 7, 14, 21 days), showing activities and unlock progress.
frontend/src/config/draftBuildLabel.ts: Configuration file that returns a draft version label string for preview build identification.
frontend/src/content/contact.ts: Exports the contact email address constant for the application.
frontend/src/content/founderStory.ts: Contains the founder's narrative about how GrowInLove was created during a four-day app competition to strengthen their own relationship.
Defines the interface and array of landing page screenshots with image paths and captions for hero and carousel displays.
frontend/src/contexts/ThemeContext.tsx: Provides a React context for managing theme state (light/dark/system) with localStorage persistence, system preference detection, and Tailwind-compatible DOM class application.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and manages an ICP backend actor with authentication, automatically recreating it when identity changes and invalidating dependent queries.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity authentication context and hooks for login/logout, managing identity state with AuthClient and delegation validation.
frontend/src/hooks/usePrefersReducedMoti: Custom hook that detects and tracks the user's prefers-reduced-motion media query preference for accessibility.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for all backend API calls including admin checks, pairing, rituals, quizzes, challenges, insights, and garden progress with proper caching and invalidation.
frontend/src/hooks/useSectionEntrance.ts: Custom hook using IntersectionObserver to detect when a section enters the viewport for entrance animations, respecting reduced motion preferences.
frontend/src/hooks/useTheme.ts: Re-exports the useTheme hook from ThemeContext for backward compatibility.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom romantic-themed color variables (berry/wine palette) for light and dark modes, plus utility animations for garden, glow, and fade effects.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query, Internet Identity provider, and renders the root App component.
frontend/src/pages/Activities.tsx: Activities page displaying spin wheel, challenges, XP module, streak badges, and rewards; requires authentication and pairing (or admin override) to access.
frontend/src/pages/Garden.tsx: Displays the Love Garden visualization showing relationship progress through plants/flowers that grow based on completed rituals and milestones. Handles garden creation, access control for paired users/admins, celebration animations for new rewards, and various loading/error states.
frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx: Main home page displaying daily rituals with prompts, text/photo/audio response options, ritual history entries, and completion status. Includes modal dialogs for viewing full ritual details, photo uploads, and displays harmony scores with love language focus indicators.
frontend/src/pages/Insights.tsx: Analytics dashboard showing relationship metrics including current/longest streaks, average harmony score, harmony trend breakdown (quiz overlap, completion rate), love language compatibility, milestone badges, and historical ritual completion data. Includes celebration animations for newly unlocked badges.
frontend/src/pages/Landing.tsx: Public landing page with hero section, feature highlights, screenshot carousel, privacy/security information, FAQ section, and call-to-action buttons. Includes navigation header with theme toggle and login button, plus footer dialogs for terms/privacy/contact.
frontend/src/pages/LoveLanguages.tsx: Interactive love languages quiz with multiple-choice questions that calculates and displays ranked love language preferences (Words of Affirmation, Quality Time, Receiving Gifts, Acts of Service, Physical Touch). Includes results visualization, partner comparison, retake functionality, and backend synchronization.
frontend/src/pages/Memories.tsx: Displays a paginated list of past ritual entries with expandable cards showing prompts, responses, photos, and love language focus. Includes photo upload/display functionality and date formatting utilities.
frontend/src/pages/Us.tsx: Manages partner pairing flow with code generation/entry, displays paired partner profile, shows combined quiz results, and includes admin controls for prompt initialization. Features celebration animations and one-time highlight effects.
frontend/src/utils/coupleLevel.ts: Calculates couple level and XP progression from insights data (streaks, challenges, harmony) using a progressive leveling formula. Provides level labels like 'New Journey' to 'Legendary Couple'.
frontend/src/utils/harmony.ts: Provides utility functions for harmony score display including percentage conversion, 7-day trend normalization, and trend direction calculation with visual indicators (up/down/stable).
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Handles URL parameter extraction from both query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence for parameters like admin tokens. Includes cleanup functions to remove sensitive params from URLs.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining the design system with romantic color palette, custom fonts (Nunito, Quicksand, Comfortaa), animation keyframes, and plugin integrations for typography and container queries.
project_state.json: Project metadata tracking implemented features (XP system, badges, memories, rituals) and pending Love Garden feature requirements including visual garden progression tied to relationship milestones with specified image assets.
